scope: skill extraction only, no ranking; no original PDF directory reads
metrics: micro per-document casefolded canonical skill set exact match; no skill-family substitution
limitations: Existing expected_skills references are not newly independently reviewed.
The dictionary and model were previously tuned/trained using parts of this corpus; this is diagnostic, not a blind holdout.
Structured JSON texts contain excerpts; a reference skill absent from the excerpt still counts as a false negative.
A predicted skill absent from expected_skills may be a valid unlabelled mention, so FP means a label mismatch until reviewed.
